## Cerebras Systems Faces Fresh Valuation Test After Lovable Deal

A valuation reset risk on a pre-earnings AI chip name that just completed a deal is a compounding risk event; if investor scrutiny intensifies before the earnings print, multiple compression could precede any fundamental validation from results.

- CBRS is flagged as facing a 'fresh valuation test' following its Lovable deal — language implying the deal raised rather than resolved investor questions about the stock's pricing.
- The article ties CBRS's wafer-scale AI compute positioning to the investor scrutiny, framing it as a strategic-versus-valuation tension.
